name: reset_polarity_flip
content: If the design has asynchronous or synchronous reset, invert its polarity once (e.g., if(rst)->if(!rst)) and make any minimal changes needed so the code still compiles.

name: off_by_one_counter
content: If there is a counter or loop, modify exactly one terminal comparison or increment/decrement by ±1 to create an off-by-one bug.

name: condition_negation
content: Choose exactly one conditional expression and widen, narrow, or negate it (e.g., <-><=, ==->!=) while keeping the code valid.

name: blocking_nonblocking_swap_seq
content: Inside a clocked always block only, replace exactly one non-blocking assignment with blocking or vice versa. Do not touch combinational blocks.

name: width_mismatch
content: Change exactly one signal, vector width, or slice so that an assignment truncates or zero-extends (e.g., assign y = x[8:1];) while remaining syntactically valid.

name: logic_error
content: Modify exactly one logical operator (&&, ||, !) or control condition to an incorrect form that changes behavior but still compiles.

name: assignment_style
content: In a combinational always block, change exactly one assignment style from blocking to non-blocking or vice versa, keeping the code valid.

name: initialization_fault
content: Change exactly one reset or initial value to an incorrect one (e.g., 1'b0->1'b1 or 8'd0->8'd4) while maintaining syntax correctness.

name: data_handling
content: Alter exactly one data-handling operation such as signedness, concatenation, or cast (e.g., remove $signed, modify a literal base, or flip endian bits) while keeping code valid.

name: state_machine
content: In a finite-state machine, modify exactly one state transition, next-state assignment, or encoding constant to an incorrect value while keeping the case structure syntactically correct.

name: comparison_operator
content: Replace exactly one comparison operator (==, !=, <, <=, >, >=) with a similar but incorrect one at a single site.

name: bitwise_operator
content: Change exactly one bitwise or shift operator (&, |, ^, ~, <<, >>) to a different operator at one location, preserving valid widths.

name: condition_priority
content: In a nested if/else or case statement, reorder or alter one condition to change which branch executes first while keeping syntax correct.

name: signal_declaration
content: Modify exactly one signal declaration or port property (e.g., width, direction, or type wire/reg/logic) so that semantics change but the design still compiles.

name: arithmetic_operator
content: Replace exactly one arithmetic operator (+, -, *, /, %) with another valid operator, or adjust one operand constant (e.g., +1→+2), ensuring no divide-by-zero.

name: value_literal
content: Change exactly one numeric constant or parameter value (e.g., 6'h04->6'h05) that affects behavior, keeping widths compatible.

name: other_minor
content: Introduce a small but compiling perturbation not covered above, such as removing a redundant signal, reordering statements, or adding an inert delay that still changes functional behavior.
